restaurant_name: La Nitivadee Dermatology & Aesthetic Laser Center
text:
I arranged an appointment by telephone for the Dr to check a dark area on my nose.
The Dr did not have a receptionist and was manning the front desk herself. I was kept waiting for 10 minutes in an uncomfortably hot reception area before she examined me. The area was only cooled by a fan as the old Air Con unit wasn’t switched on. I was advised to have a skin biopsy of the area. I was quoted 15000 THB, which the Dr said was half of what we would pay at Bangkok hospital, 30000 THB.
I found the Dr very stern and abrupt ordering me to take off my shoes, while not providing slippers.
My husband was with me for my appointments and has since also found a skin growth on his face. He was also not impressed with my experience here and chose to go to Pattaya International hospital instead. They have removed the spot completely, sent it for biopsy all for a cost of less than 10,000 THB (including antibiotics, plasters, etc)in a clean and cool hospital.

text:
I had a spot on my back that was worrying me. Then it started to ooze. I started looking for a dermatologist. After checking out a few I landed on La Nitivadee. Her reviews were great.

I arrived at the clinic for my appointment and had zero waiting time. Dr Nitivadee took me into a room and examined the spot. As suspected, it was a cyst. She asked if I wanted it removed now and I said absolutely.

We went back to another room and she prepared me for the removal. The whole process took about an hour. The cyst ended being a double cyst and was pretty deep. She stitched me up using subcuticular sutures. This prevents me from having a hole in my back.

I can’t say enough good things about Dr Nitivadee. She is very knowledgeable and personable. Couldn’t have been any kinder.

On a side note, she also noticed a bump on my nose and diagnosed it as Basel Cell Carcinoma. I plan on having her remove it.

So, for any skin care issues, please, give La Nitivadee a shot at fixing you up.
